// @camis:generated — do not edit; regenerated by camis
import { Router } from "express";
import { asc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { asyncRoute } from "../async-route";
import { db } from "../db/client";
import { entries } from "../db/schema";
import { tooLong } from "../lengths";

function pick(obj: Record<string, unknown>, keys: string[]): Record<string, unknown> {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const k of keys) if (k in obj) out[k] = obj[k];
  return out;
}

const find = async (id: number) =>
  (await db.select().from(entries).where(eq(entries.id, id)).limit(1))[0];

/** Each bounded field's maxLength, in characters. */
const MAX_LENGTHS: Record<string, number> = { code: 40, body: 1000, notes: 2000, contact: 320, slug: 300 };

export const entriesRouter = Router();

entriesRouter.get("/", asyncRoute(async (_req, res) => {
  res.json(await db.select().from(entries).orderBy(asc(entries.id)));
}));

entriesRouter.get("/:id(\\d+)", asyncRoute(async (req, res) => {
  const row = await find(Number(req.params.id));
  if (!row) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "not found" });
    return;
  }
  res.json(row);
}));

entriesRouter.post("/", asyncRoute(async (req, res) => {
  const longer = tooLong(req.body, MAX_LENGTHS);
  if (longer !== null) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: longer });
    return;
  }
  const data = pick(req.body, ["title", "code", "body", "notes", "contact", "slug"]);
  const [{ id }] = await db.insert(entries).values(data).returning({ id: entries.id });
  const row = await find(id);
  if (!row) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "not found" });
    return;
  }
  res.status(201).json(row);
}));

entriesRouter.patch("/:id(\\d+)", asyncRoute(async (req, res) => {
  const longer = tooLong(req.body, MAX_LENGTHS);
  if (longer !== null) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: longer });
    return;
  }
  const id = Number(req.params.id);
  const data = pick(req.body, ["title", "code", "body", "notes", "contact", "slug"]);
  if (Object.keys(data).length > 0)
    await db.update(entries).set(data).where(eq(entries.id, id));
  const row = await find(id);
  if (!row) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "not found" });
    return;
  }
  res.json(row);
}));

entriesRouter.delete("/:id(\\d+)", asyncRoute(async (req, res) => {
  const id = Number(req.params.id);
  await db.delete(entries).where(eq(entries.id, id));
  res.status(204).end();
}));
